description: For home security install, this request form records device placement, privacy preferences, power and connectivity, communication path, permits, testing, and user training. use_case: Use the request form during home security system installation and activation when the home security install record must identify account, premises, zones, panel, sensors, cameras, network, monitoring plan, users, and emergency contacts. Complete the applicable handoff for zone verification, monitoring activation, user credential handoff, training acknowledgment, privacy settings, and support plan.
